attchmntText: BF Investment Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Interim Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: BF Investment Limited has fixed November 20, 2026, as the record date for determining eligibility for an interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. The dividend is set at INR 20 per equity share of face value INR 5. Shareholders whose names appear in the Register of Members or depository records as of November 20, 2026, are eligible. Payment of the interim dividend will be completed on or before December 12, 2026.

attchmntText: BF Investment Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 20 per equity share.
voiceSummary: BF Investment Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board declared an Interim Dividend of Rs. 20.00 per equity share of Rs. 5 each for the Financial Year 2026-27. The Record Date for this dividend is Friday, November 20, 2026. Payment will be completed on or before December 12, 2026. Standalone profit after tax for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 510.70 million. Consolidated profit after tax for the same period was Rs. 465.13 million. Earnings per share for the quarter were Rs. 13.56 on a standalone basis and Rs. 12.35 on a consolidated basis. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board.

attchmntText: BF Investment Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
